data.name: Waste No Space
data.detailed_description:
In WASTE NO SPACE you explore the unknown to find new technology while constantly balancing resources and pollution. Think ahead, be strategic, or simply fill the void with nuclear waste!

Your job is simple: Produce power by building more and more reactors. Then, shoot the radioactive waste into space! Watch our beautiful galaxy as it gets filled up with greenish glowing packages full of left-overs.

Fling satellites into orbit and explore what is out there! Find new tech to help you reach farther out and survive longer. Find out about nerdy space facts to brag about during the next conversation with a sexy alien.

The more waste you shoot into space, the tighter it gets up there and you will end your game by drowning your planet in toxic garbage. On the bright side: You get points for everything, but mostly for how long you managed to survive, how much power you produced and how much waste you sent into space.

So what's it about?

I designed Waste No Space to be easy to play but hard to master. You can play it casually for a few minutes or try to beat the game again and again to achieve a new high score and unlock all collectible fragments out there.

It is a game about precision and tactics, while being satisfying to play with.

How to play?

You have your available technology on the left side. Build new reactors to generate more power, but also more waste. Use your mouse to shoot that waste into space, before your planet overflows with nuclear garbage. To shoot waste into space, simply click and drag from your planet and let go. Like a slingshot. Or that game about mean birds.

Features:

  • Weird dialogues with your higher ups!

  • Calming music and nerve wrecking alarm sounds!

  • Beat the high-score!

  • Unlock and update new technology to help you survive longer!

  • Destroy your planet in unforeseen ways!

  • Shoot weird space blobbs with radioactive packages

  • Collect all the secrets of the galaxy! (in development)

  • Grind the achievements! (in development)

data.short_description: Explore space, find hidden objects and beat your high score - while trying not to drown in the nuclear waste you produce! Research technology, manage your resources and achieve extra goodies with galactic events!
